annotations.text:
Media slots

Six placeholders: lead-photo, story-1-chart, story-2-photo, story-3-photo, and the two data panels (prices-chart, flows-map) which ship with a drawn sample.

On the canvas, seed an image with --image and reference it by bare filename. In the repo, add it to assets/manifest.json instead.

Live data app

Set the liveDataUrl tweak above the artboard. Until it has a value the market rail is labelled SAMPLE FEED and the call to action points at an anchor rather than pretending to be wired up.

Copy

Headlines and standfirsts are drafted, illustrative editorial. Every hard fact is bracketed — [XX]%, [MONTH], [REPORTER NAME], [YEAR] — so nothing reads as a claim until it is filled in.
